chapter.heading: Hebrews 8
Jesus, High Priest of a Better Covenant
chapter.v: one who is seated at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
it is necessary for this priest also to have something to offer.
Now if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, since there are priests who offer gifts according to the law.
“See that you make everything according to the pattern that was shown you on the mountain.”
he mediates is better, since it is enacted on better promises.
For if that first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no occasion to look for a second.
and with the house of Judah,
and so I showed no concern for them, declares the Lord.
and they shall be my people.
from the least of them to the greatest.
and I will remember their sins no more.”
what is becoming obsolete and growing old is ready to vanish away.
